crossRefs.note: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given…
There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all…
where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person…
Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and…
Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect: not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister…
Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,
Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.
“So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day…
In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to…
Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you…
casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

translations.web: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.
translations.bsb: Were you a slave when you were called? Do not let it concern you—but if you can gain your freedom, take the opportunity.
translations.kjv: Art thou called being a servant? care ➔ not for it: but if thou mayest be made free, use it rather.
translations.asv: Wast thou called being a bondservant? Care not for it: nay, even if thou canst become free, use it rather.
